info.title: Human Ticketing Console Control Plane API
info.description: Machine-readable contract for the local, human-in-the-loop REST control plane. Paths include the versioned protocol prefix and intentionally define no deployment address. The API exposes observation, lifecycle, reminders, explicit human confirmation, and redacted audit operations only.

get.summary: Read process liveness without accessing devices
Read side-effect-free host resources and tool readiness
List planning-only provider profiles and estimated capacity

post.summary: Start one device after explicit confirmation
Stop one device and its preview after explicit confirmation
Reconnect one device after explicit confirmation
Start the focused device's read-only preview
Stop one read-only preview after explicit confirmation
Select one focus device without sending input

get.summary: List schedules ordered by start time

post.summary: Record that a human saw a fired reminder

get.summary: Read the monotonic clock confidence snapshot

post.summary: Issue a short-lived one-use human confirmation ticket
Stop all active adapters after explicit confirmation

get.summary: Page through newest-first redacted audit records
Export retained redacted audit records as JSON

RequestIdHeader.name: X-Request-Id
RequestIdHeader.description: Optional caller correlation id. Invalid values are replaced with a generated id.

OperatorIdHeader.name: X-Operator-Id
OperatorIdHeader.description: Audit identity for registration and schedule mutations; defaults to local-user.

RequestId.description: Correlation id echoed in the response body.

HostProbe.description: Side-effect-free host resource and tool readiness snapshot.

HostProviders.description: Planning-only provider profiles and conservative capacity estimates.

StopAll.description: All active mock adapters were stopped.

PolicyDenied.description: The operation or supplied content is outside policy.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

ConflictError.description: Current state, capacity, idempotency, or confirmation sequence conflicts with the request.

ValidationError.description: Request path, query, header, or body validation failed.

ConfirmationRequired.description: A valid explicit human confirmation is required.

ServiceUnavailable.description: A bounded queue, cache, ticket store, or adapter is temporarily unavailable.

InternalError.description: An unexpected internal error occurred without exposing internal details.

Reminder.description: Reminder targets must be strictly later than the control-plane current time when a schedule is created or updated.

UpdateScheduleRequest.description: Use the cancelled branch alone for cancellation; label/reminders updates cannot be combined with state.
